1.3.0.name: Wet EQ
1.3.0.author: yonie
1.3.0.description: An open-source four-band British console equaliser modelled as a circuit: saturation inside the filter loop, per-stage crosstalk, gain-dependent bandwidth. Free, MIT, VST3 for Windows, macOS and Linux.
1.3.0.changes:
**WetEQ 1.3.0**

Product page: https://wetvst.com/weteq/

What's new:

- added 50% zoom percentage for even smaller plugin GUI (so you can fit more plugins on your screen)
- plugins now open on 75% scale by default, right click a panel to change it's size

1.0.0.name: Wet EQ
1.0.0.author: yonie
1.0.0.description: An open-source four-band British console equaliser modelled as a circuit: saturation inside the filter loop, per-stage crosstalk, gain-dependent bandwidth. Free, MIT, VST3 for Windows, macOS and Linux.
1.0.0.changes: First release. Four-band console EQ with HPF, LPF and input gain. Eleven stepped controls, nine positions each, and no Q control. Per-channel L/R metering. Runs at the host sample rate.
